messages:
Sam Nguyen: Heads-up — I'm iterating the PRD for the tiered failover / smart routing policy. Need scope + launch gates agreed by EOD Thu. Sharing a rough checklist in-thread. https://go/repo/prd-draft :link: 
Maria Patel: Quick Q — do we include region-aware routing in the initial beta? Acme and Gov customer asked for it explicitly.
Leo Chen: My read: region-aware full failover was scoped out for v2 in the workshop. MVP should prefer local replicas and do tenant-region affinity, but not full cross-region fallback.
Joni Alvarez: Customers also asked for a model compatibility matrix (e.g., int8 vs fp16 vs quantized). We need acceptance criteria for downgrade semantics (when we fall back to a compatible variant).
Sam Nguyen: Proposed high-level acceptance criteria (MVP):
- 1) Fallback tiers are declaratively defined per route + tenant (tier, region, variants).
- 2) Latency SLOs (p50/p95) must not regress by >30% on average during normal ops.
- 3) Canary rollout + automatic rollback: 5% traffic canary, health checks every 30s.
- 4) Observability: traces include routing decision + fallback reason, metrics for fallback counts and downstream errors.
- 5) Customer pilot: at least one paying customer (Acme/Gov) signed up for pilot before GA.
Maria Patel: Edge-case: KV cache invalidation when switching model variants in the middle of a chat session. We can't drop conversational context. Need a migration or sticky session rule.
Leo Chen: Agreed. Also: tokenization mismatch across variants (e.g., different tokenizer leading to shifted token ids). Acceptance test: for any supported variant pair, same prompt -> output tokens aligned within <2 token shift for >95% prompts.
Joni Alvarez: Operational playbook notes: if fallback chain triggers due to capacity, system must tag traces with `routing.fallback_reason` and include `fallback_chain` field with the tier names. Also include runbook step: if fallback rate > 1% for 10min, auto-alert to oncall + paging policy.
Sam Nguyen: Example fallback config (MVP) — keep simple:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: chat.default
    tiers:
      - name: local-pref
        regions: [us-east-1]
        variants: [gptx-1.0-fp16, gptx-1.0-int8]
      - name: conserved-cost
        regions: [multi]
        variants: [gptx-1.0-quant]
    canary: 5%
    latency_slo_ms: 1200
```
Maria Patel: That looks fine. For Gov tenants we should enforce `regions: [gov-west]` and disallow cross-region fallback by policy.
Leo Chen: Scope negotiation proposal: MVP excludes automatic quantization conversion and cross-region reroute. That reduces engineering risk and perf unknowns. We can still allow manual fallbacks to quantized variants if customer opts in.
Joni Alvarez: Edge cases to capture in PRD acceptance/tests: function-calling contract drift, structured output schema differences, embedding vector dimension mismatches when falling back to different model family.
Product Bot: Reminder — launch gating checklist: security review ✅, perf benchmarks (target < p95 1.2s for 512 tokens), pilot customer signed, docs and Console UX for toggling routing.
Deploy Bot: PRD updated (link: https://go/repo/prd-draft) — pushed latest compatibility matrix and CI test stubs.
Sam Nguyen: Action items: Maria — draft customer-impact matrix + pilot ask; Leo — compatibility matrix + test harness; Joni — runbook + pager playbook. I'll merge acceptance criteria into PRD and re-circulate for final signoff. Deadline: Thu EOD.
Maria Patel: Sounds good, I'm on the customer matrix. :thumbsup:
Leo Chen: I'll spike the tokenizer alignment tests and share perf run notes by Wed.
Joni Alvarez: I'll draft the runbook and a short postmortem template for any fallback incidents.
Sam Nguyen: Thanks all — if no objections I'll lock scope at EOD and start scheduling the pilot outreach. :rocket:
